name: T4 Launcher
tagline: simple launcher with predictive text filtering
blurb: Simple launcher consisting of a scrollable list of apps with predictive text filtering using 4 buttons.
description:
Simple launcher consisting of a scrollable list of apps with predictive text filtering using 4 buttons.

- short press launches app
- long press opens app settings
- back button removes last input
- home button clears input
- long press back button reloads list

Example for input [A_F][A_F][S_Z][S_Z]
